notes.title: Steam page of our new game, TerraStorm, just went live!
notes.notes:
In the TerraStorm world, the Second World War ended differently. In our timeline, the Nazis obtained a new mysterious resource viribus, and decided to use it in bombs dropped on all of their enemies. It wiped most of humanity and destroyed the planet.
 
People that survived the war decided to cooperate across boundaries to survive tomorrow, thanks to the deadly resource, now used for the good cause. 

Mankind entrusts just one, last corporation - ROSE, that resides in The Capitol, and appointed Project Towers. Architects are responsible for building The Towers, the only safe place left on the planet. You are the first one of them. 

We can't wait to hear your thoughts about TerraStorm - [url=https://bit.ly/TerraStorm_Discord]join our Discord[/url] to stay in touch with us!

[url=https://bit.ly/TerraStorm][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36873548/22cb031ae2ba7a5b2ddd25a193de359de33693f0.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is out NOW!
notes.notes:
Hey folks! We want to thank you for your support, feedback, and interest in Your Story. For some time, we've been working on patch 1.1, and we're finally ready to share it with you. It's available now for everyone who has the game here on Steam. List of changes below: 

[list]
[*] minor fixes 
[*] entirely new ending for one of the major routes, 
[*] improvements with Hilda's, Cirdan's, and Henrietta's routes with new dedicated illustrations and texts, 
[*] over 6000 new words in the game,
[*] a couple of new secret endings, 
[*] seven (7) new Steam achievements. 
[/list]

If you encounter a bug, please report it here on Steam or our Discord server [url=https://discord.gg/FgsaqrR]HERE[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1247740/Your_Story/

notes.title: First patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey folks! Thanks for your constant support. We're working on improving the game. In the meantime, we prepared a small patch for you. Here is the list of changes:

[list]
[*] We've added a Mac OS version, 
[*] Balanced voiceovers and added the possibility to turn them off with a "volume voice" bar, 
[*] Balanced music volume, 
[*] Some bad endings are easier to find/achieve,
[*] Going to the Village triggers the passing of time,
[*] Fixed the bug with disappearing Ove during the conversation, 
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause some quests to multiply in the journal,
[*] Minor fixing with misspellings,
[*] Fixed a typo in the Chinese version that could cause the game to crash.
[/list]

If you encounter a bug, please report it here on Steam or our Discord server [url=https://discord.gg/FgsaqrR]HERE[/url]. 

---

notes.notes:

We thank you for your support and feedback. We hear everything and want to improve the whole game for you. If you want to discuss the game, please join our Discord server [url=https://discord.gg/FgsaqrR]HERE[/url]. 

Below is the short plan for the upcoming two months.

notes.title: Release window, new localization & MORE!
notes.notes:
Hey folks! 

Winter holidays are almost here, and before that we wanted to share with you another update regarding our game. We hope you're going to like it! We're going to talk about a couple of things. Let's start with the following:

[b]Release window [/b]

First of all, a message everyone (or at least we hope) waited for. We will publish the game in January. We will also share the exact day of the release at the beginning of the new year. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36873548/161c885bb4014a2fb23742dbd6534ad80b78d154.png[/img]

[b]New demo & Chinese localization[/b]

With this news we’ve also updated the demo. Right now you can download it from Steam with a couple of new things, and a new language to choose. From now on you can play the demo in Simplified Chinese. 

[b]Work status[/b]

At this moment we are finished with almost everything and we can play the game from the beginning to the end. We just need some more testing to eliminate bugs, and polish everything.

If you want to talk about the new demo or the upcoming full release - we invite you to join our Discord server [url=https://discord.com/invite/FgsaqrR]HERE[/url].

[b]Happy holidays![/b]

notes.title: Hello there... again
notes.notes:
Hey folks! For the last months, we have been working on making Your Story for you. Today we want to share the newest version of our demo and tell you about the status of our progress. If you want to try the game, go to our store page and download it. 

What can you expect? 

First of all, as we said before: our main goal was to create a better version of the game, and we changed a lot - staying, of course, close to our core idea. You can expect new graphics, more detailed characters, new backgrounds, and dedicated art. We also write everything from scratch to make it "sound" better, along with a whole new game code. In this demo, we are showing you the beginning of the game in which you can get acquainted with most of the characters and check some basic mechanics. Let us know what you think on our Discord server [url=https://discord.gg/FgsaqrR]HERE[/url]. 

What is the status of the work?

[list]
[*] Writing [97%] - in this area, we are almost done. The main story is ready, and we're polishing the alternate endings. 
[*] Translating [10%] - to be honest, we've translated only text for the demo, and we're waiting for a fully finished script. 
[*] Art [70%] - we did almost everything we needed to fulfill the base needs, like characters, backgrounds, items, etc. From now on, we'll be creating as many dedicated arts and story comics as possible to make the game as visually compelling and dynamic as it gets. 
[*] Programming [20%] - base code is ready, so from now it's a "simple" path forward with coding the scenes that are already written as a script. We believe we can do it soon with new team members helping in this area. 
Of course, remember that this percentage is more or less accurate. With this, we can assure you that we'll deliver the game this year, but we need a little more time to tell precisely which day it will be. 
[/list]
